exercise.rubric: <font color="#000000">Match the words and their definitions.</font>

questions.sentence: <font color="#000000">A moment in a game or negotiation where no one can win. </font>[stalemate]
<font color="#000000">A smaller company owned by a larger one. </font>[subsidiary]
<font color="#000000">Your bosses, all the people that you report to at work. </font>[superiors]
<font color="#000000">Not generating a profit, losing money. </font>[loss-making]
<font color="#000000">To close a factory or a company, and completely stop working. </font>[shut down]
<font color="#000000">Anything that people need to discuss, a problem. </font>[issue]
<font color="#000000">A situation where everyone benefits. </font>[mutual gain]
